introducer.title: editor: fix @vscode/diff bridge, report diff validity in telemetry

cases.mechanism: The external diff adapters ignored the caller's time budget and synchronously computed the full diff in the shared editor worker, allowing CPU work and awaited diff-render latency to grow without the configured 5-second bound.
cases.symptom: Opening or updating a large/pathological diff with advanced-external or advanced-wasm could keep the editor worker occupied and delay diff rendering past diffEditor.maxComputationTime instead of quitting early.
cases.fixedBehavior: The bridge now passes options.maxComputationTimeMs into @vscode/diff, so external JavaScript and WASM computations can terminate at the same configured budget as the built-in advanced algorithm and return a coarse timed-out result rather than running to completion.
cases.evidence: The base bridge explicitly omitted maxComputationTimeMs on the synchronous @vscode/diff computeDiff call (base line 59), while DiffEditorViewModel awaits WorkerBasedDocumentDiffProvider.computeDiff before committing/rendering the result, and the worker invokes diffAlgorithm.computeDiff synchronously. The UI option defaults to 5000 ms and is documented as cancelling computation after that budget, but advanced-external/advanced-wasm discarded it; large or pathological diffs could therefore keep the editor worker busy and leave the diff editor awaiting a result beyond the configured bound. Blame identifies cf676eb9119f308cb6337e778689af22a38152a2 as introducing the omitted-forwarding line.
